name: Proton Pass
description: Proton Pass built into Spotty: search your vault and copy passwords, usernames and one-time codes
author: spotty
help:
Proton Pass, built into Spotty

Installing adds the `pass` trigger and a Proton Pass row under Settings → Search → Services and integrations. Spotty includes Proton's official Pass client, so no separate Proton app or CLI is needed.

Type `pass` and a few letters of an item's title, its vault or its kind (`pass git`, `pass work`, `pass card`). Enter copies the password; the best match also offers Copy username, Copy one-time code, Open website and Copy username, password and code, which pastes the three one after another. Selecting an item shows its username, its password (masked, never revealed), its one-time code and its website in the preview pane, each with a copy button. Card items copy the card number or security code, notes copy their text, and other items open in Proton Pass.

Signing in: Proton Pass has its own sign-in. Open Settings → Proton Pass and type your Proton email and password. Spotty passes them to Proton's Pass client through a terminal it opens for the client (never stored, never on a command line), and answers its two-factor or mailbox prompts the same way. Pass keeps its own session; no other Proton app's sign-in is used.

Privacy: Spotty loads only item titles, vault names and item kinds into memory (search covers those; usernames and web addresses are not in Proton Pass's listing, so they aren't searched). Passwords, usernames, one-time codes and notes are read from Proton Pass at the moment you copy them, are marked as passwords on the clipboard (so Spotty's clipboard history skips them), and are cleared from the clipboard after the delay you choose in Settings (30 seconds by default). The vault window (Open vault in Settings, or Open Proton Pass vault from the trigger) browses, views and copies items; it never creates, edits or deletes them. An optional PIN locks Spotty's use of Pass, with auto-lock from 1 minute to 4 hours; locking forgets the listing. A copy-all sequence ends after 60 seconds, when Pass locks, or when something else is copied. Vault items never appear in the everyday search. The client runs with its update check and telemetry switched off and keeps its key in your desktop keyring, which must be unlocked.

Uninstalling removes the trigger only; use Settings → Proton Pass → Sign out to remove Pass's session.
